title: Among the (port status, device owner) pairs returned by the existing port a
question: Among the (port status, device owner) pairs returned by the existing port aggregation (only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks), list only those pairs where more than 25% of the ports are DOWN ports on network ID '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d' that have a security-group binding. For each qualifying pair, show the total port count, the earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, the count of such DOWN+security-group ports, and the resulting ratio. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base_ports AS (
  SELECT 
    p.status,
    p.device_owner,
    p.id AS port_id,
    p.network_id,
    sa.updated_at,
    CASE WHEN sgpb.port_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_sg_binding
  FROM ports p
  INNER JOIN standardattributes sa ON p.standard_attr_id = sa.id
  WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM networkrbacs nr
      WHERE nr.object_id = p.network_id
        AND nr.action = 'access_as_shared'
        AND (nr.target_tenant = '*' OR nr.target_tenant = p.tenant_id)
    )
  LEFT JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON p.id = sgpb.port_id
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    status,
    device_owner,
    COUNT(port_id) AS total_port_count,
    MIN(updated_at) AS earliest_updated,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DOWN' AND network_id = '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d' AND has_sg_binding = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS down_sg_count
  FROM base_ports
  GROUP BY status, device_owner
)
SELECT 
  status,
  device_owner,
  total_port_count,
  earliest_updated,
  down_sg_count,
  down_sg_count / total_port_count AS ratio
FROM grouped
WHERE down_sg_count / total_port_count > 0.25

SELECT p.status,
       p.device_owner,
       COUNT(*) AS total_port_count,
       MIN(sa.updated_at) AS earliest_updated_at,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'DOWN'
                AND p.network_id = '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d'
                AND sg.port_id IS NOT NULL
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS down_sg_port_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'DOWN'
                AND p.network_id = '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d'
                AND sg.port_id IS NOT NULL
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS ratio
FROM ports p
JOIN standardattributes sa ON sa.id = p.standard_attr_id
JOIN networks n ON n.id = p.network_id
LEFT JOIN securitygroupportbindings sg ON sg.port_id = p.id
WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
  AND n.tenant_id IS NULL
GROUP BY p.status, p.device_owner
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'DOWN'
                AND p.network_id = '0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d'
                AND sg.port_id IS NOT NULL
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0.25 * COUNT(*)
ORDER BY p.status, p.device_owner;
